environment.description: Kubernetes deployment on EKS 1.27 with default namespace. Pod runs as root (UID 0) with hostPath volume mount at /data/documents pointing to the node's /mnt/shared-nfs/documents. No network policy restricting pod-to-pod traffic. Service exposed via NodePort. PodSecurityPolicy admission controller is NOT enabled (deprecated in 1.25+). No Pod Security Standards enforcement label on namespace.
